description: Explore Trello workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Atlassian

Trello

Trello organises work through boards, lists and cards for lightweight planning and team coordination.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Structure a delivery board

Begin with the approved project dataset, calendar and reporting grain. In the intended Trello preview, structure a delivery board; the visible result is a structured planning or reporting view with source fields visible. Review data ownership, dates, relationships and completeness before accepting or exporting it.

Move work through a workflow

Use the selected measures, activities, resources or work items. In the intended Trello preview, move work through a workflow; the visible result is a decision view that exposes status, sequence and capacity. Review definitions, dependencies, resource limits and stale data before accepting or exporting it.

Review blockers and ownership

Start from the current baseline, progress cut-off and governance rules. In the intended Trello preview, review blockers and ownership; the visible result is a reviewed forecast, report or delivery board with exceptions visible. Review variance, critical work, blockers and accountable ownership before accepting or exporting it.
